title: WHAT IF YOU HAD 5 CLONES? 👥😱 (The Deadly Betrayal) #Shorts
description:
What if you discovered a machine that could clone you 5 times? 👥🧬
For 3 months, Pip lived like a digital god: Clone 1 worked 80 hours a week, Clone 2 got six-pack abs, Clone 3 mastered quantum physics, while Pip gamed all day.

Then on Day 90... Pip woke up tied to a cold metal chair! The clones held a secret vote: 'The original is lazy, defective, and useless. It's time to replace him permanently.' 🪑😱

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
👉 Option A: "TERMINATE ALL 5 CLONES! (Hit the emergency kill switch)"
👉 Option B: "SURRENDER YOUR CONTROL! (Let the smarter clones run your life)"

Drop your choice in the comments below! 👇
